caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Feb 8–13.

Before touch footy or futsal, a 10-minute warm-up building to 3–4 short sprints gets you ready. In race week, skip any new massage; if you book one, go 2–4 days out with lighter pressure. A pain diary only needs one line a day, and patterns over a week or two tell you more than one bad day. In appointments, practise your exercises and film them.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Calf swelling and warmth, or a knee that locks, needs a check. Book online via the link in bio
